items.html: And the reason that they are not ten complete [years] is that the skull is not made in him until after the second Ibur of AVI; therefore the skull is counted only as one day. For immediately, at the beginning of the tenth year, he is impregnated a second time, in order to make a skull in him; and then he will be fit for coition. And it is found that the skull is made immediately after this Ibur, and it is made on the first day of the tenth year; and afterward, in four other years, the four Mochin enter into this skull. And behold, thirteen years and one day are completed, and behold, he is a complete man.
